user.title: Device Connection
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Akuvox device.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Select the authentication method for your device.

data_description.auth_method: Choose 'None / AllowList' if your device has no authentication or uses IP-based allowlisting.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Enter the username and password for your device.

webhook.title: Webhook Events
webhook.description: Enable webhook event delivery from this device to Home Assistant.

data_description.webhook_enabled: When enabled, the integration will configure the device to send event notifications (relay triggers, code entry) to Home Assistant.

capabilities.title: Capability safety
capabilities.description: pylocal-akuvox 1.2.0 blocks unrecognized or unknown device capabilities by default. Enable this only if you accept attempting unproven operations; confirmed unsupported capabilities remain blocked.

data_description.attempt_unknown_capability: When enabled, UNKNOWN capabilities are attempted after the device is identified. This does not bypass confirmed UNSUPPORTED capabilities, adapter failures, or device/network/authentication errors.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.webhook_push_failed: Failed to push webhook configuration to the device.

init.title: Local Akuvox Options
init.description: Update connection settings for your Akuvox device.

data_description.request_delay: Delay between consecutive API requests to the device. Increase if the device becomes unresponsive during batch operations.
data_description.attempt_unknown_capability: Attempt operations the upstream matrix marks UNKNOWN. Leave disabled for the safest behavior; confirmed UNSUPPORTED capabilities remain blocked.

schedule_type.description: Schedule mode: Date Range, Weekly, or Daily.

week.name: Week days

time_start.name: Start time
time_start.description: Daily start time for the schedule.

time_end.name: End time
time_end.description: Daily end time for the schedule.

modify_schedule.description: Update an existing access schedule on the device.

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule
delete_schedule.description: Remove an access schedule from the device.

id.name: Schedule ID
id.description: ID of the schedule to delete.

list_users.description: Retrieve user codes from the device.

add_user.name: Add user
add_user.description: Create a new user code on the device.

private_pin.name: PIN code
private_pin.description: 4-8 digit PIN code for keypad access.

card_code.name: Card code
card_code.description: Card or badge code for NFC access.

modify_user.name: Modify user
modify_user.description: Update an existing user code on the device.

id.name: User ID
id.description: Device ID of the user to modify.

delete_user.name: Delete user
delete_user.description: Remove a user code from the device.

id.name: User ID
id.description: Device ID of the user to delete.

add_user_schedule_relay.description: Add a schedule-relay pair to an existing user.

id.name: User ID

list_contacts.name: List contacts
list_contacts.description: Retrieve contacts from the device address book.

add_contact.name: Add contact
add_contact.description: Create a new contact in the device address book.

modify_contact.name: Modify contact
modify_contact.description: Update an existing contact in the device address book.

id.name: Contact ID
id.description: Device ID of the contact to modify.

delete_contact.name: Delete contact
delete_contact.description: Remove one or more contacts from the device address book.

id.name: Contact ID
id.description: Device ID of the contact(s) to delete. Accepts a single ID or comma-separated IDs.

modify_group.description: Rename an existing group on the device.

delete_group.name: Delete group

run_capability_report.name: Run capability report
run_capability_report.description: Return the redacted pylocal-akuvox 1.2.0 capability report. Use the response or optional JSON file for upstream new-device issues.

write.name: Run write tests
write.description: When enabled, the upstream write suite may create, modify, verify, and delete throwaway users, schedules, groups, and contacts, and may run relay-trigger or device-config write checks. Use only when temporary device mutations are acceptable.

open_door.name: Run OpenDoor relay test
open_door.description: Physical safety warning: OpenDoor can actuate a relay, unlock a door, or affect building access. Enable only with write mode while authorized and physically present.

open_door_user.name: OpenDoor username
open_door_user.description: Relay HTTP username required only with OpenDoor. The integration does not store, return, save, or log this value; pylocal-akuvox 1.2.0 debug logging may include the username.

open_door_password.name: OpenDoor password
open_door_password.description: Relay HTTP password required only with OpenDoor. The integration does not store, return, save, or log this password.

save_to_file.name: Save report to file
save_to_file.description: Write the same redacted report to a new JSON file below local_akuvox/capability_reports in the Home Assistant config directory. Existing files are never overwritten.

file_name.name: Report file name
file_name.description: Optional relative .json file name under local_akuvox/capability_reports. Absolute paths and traversal are rejected. Leave empty to generate a unique name.

invalid_schedule_type.message: Invalid schedule type: {schedule_type}. Must be 0, 1, or 2.

invalid_schedule_relay_format.message: Invalid schedule_relay format. Expected pairs like 1-1,2-2

cannot_remove_last_pair.message: Cannot remove the last schedule-relay pair.

capability_report_open_door_write.message: OpenDoor capability reports require write mode.

unsupported_capability.title: Akuvox capability is unsupported
unsupported_capability.description: {entry_title} could not complete {context}. Reason: {reason}; capability: {capability}; device class: {device_class}. Report this device upstream by opening a new-device issue at pylocal-akuvox and attaching this integration's diagnostics download so it can be added to the capability matrix. You can also enable Attempt unknown capabilities to try UNKNOWN capabilities; confirmed UNSUPPORTED capabilities remain blocked.
